For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor. A good screen and keyboard matter more than a strong graphics card.

Memory: 16 GB is the floor. Pick 32 GB if you run many apps, virtual machines or phone emulators at once.
Processor: a recent Ryzen 5 or 7, or Intel Core i5 or i7. Choose an "H" series chip for heavier work and a "U" series chip for longer battery.
Screen and keyboard: full HD or better at 14 to 15.6 inches, with a keyboard you like typing on for hours.
Extras: a graphics card only matters for AI training or games. Battery life matters if you work away from a plug.
